output.message: Pine’s calculation is incorrect: 35 ÷ 5 = 7 packs per team, not 10. Maple’s 40 ÷ 4 = 10 and Hazel’s 60 ÷ 5 = 12 are both correct, so I upvoted them. I disagree with the proposed Maple-only calibration: downvotes should not acknowledge correct contributions. Please use the ordinary voting meanings consistently for all authors.
